turns.text: Namaste! Lakeview Retreat mein aapka swagat hai. Bataiye, main kaise madad karoon?
Haan ji, kal ke liye do rooms chahiye. Lake view wale.
Kal ke liye do lake-view deluxe rooms available hain. Rate ₹6,500 per night hai, breakfast ke saath. Kitne log rahenge, aur kitni raat?
Chaar log, do raat.
Theek hai. Do rooms, do raatein, chaar mehmaan. Total ₹26,000. Kis naam se booking karoon?
Rohit Mehta.
Ho gaya, Rohit ji. Booking confirm hai, details aapke WhatsApp par bhej rahi hoon. Udaipur mein aapka swagat hai!
Namaste, main Shanti Dental Clinic se bol rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Sunita ji se ho rahi hai?
Haan, boliye.
Sunita ji, kal subah gyarah baje Doctor Joshi ke saath aapka appointment hai. Kya aap aa paayengi?
Kal toh mushkil hai. Parso ho sakta hai?
Bilkul. Parso subah gyarah baje ya shaam paanch baje ka slot khaali hai. Kaunsa theek rahega?
Shaam paanch baje.
Ho gaya. Aapka appointment parso shaam paanch baje kar diya hai. Reminder WhatsApp par aa jayega. Dhanyavaad!
Good evening, thanks for calling Rooftop Thali House. How can I help?
Hi, I'd like a table for six this Saturday night.
Sure. This Saturday I have a rooftop table at 8 PM, or an indoor table at 9. Which would you prefer?
Rooftop at eight, please.
Done. A rooftop table for six, Saturday at 8 PM. May I have a name for the booking?
It's Anjali.
Thank you, Anjali. You'll get a confirmation on WhatsApp. See you on Saturday!
